_comment: Copy to .muse/session-log.scrub.json in the MAIN checkout (git-ignored; never commit the real one) and replace every entry below with your own.
The file must exist: without it, with these placeholders unchanged, or unreadable, no digest is written. {"replace": {}} is the only way to say there is nothing to hide.
Each key is a literal that must never reach docs/prompts/sessions: host names and aliases, user@host forms, service users, cloud project ids. Longer literals are replaced first.

A literal is replaced in any case and also inside longer words (prod-box-name2, ProdBoxNameVM). A literal listed in "words" (a short or ordinary word) is replaced only where no letter touches it. Literals under 4 characters must be listed in "words".
A replacement must not contain any literal. A digest that still contains a literal after the scrub is not written; the reason goes to .muse/session-log/errors.log.
node .muse/hooks/session-log.mjs --audit lists the tracked files that already hold these literals.
